name: slider
purpose: Picks a number, or a range with two thumbs, from a bounded scale such as volume, a price range, or working hours. Each thumb is a WAI-ARIA slider; range thumbs limit each other. Keyboard by step, large step, and ends; pointer press and drag. A Form control with hidden inputs for native submission.
whenToUse: Approximate values where the position on a scale matters more than the exact number: volume, opacity, rating thresholds.
A range filter such as a price or a working-hours window.
whenNotToUse: Exact numbers the user types: use Number Input.
Scales with more than a few hundred steps where precision matters (pair the slider with a Number Input or use one).
Choosing among named options: use Radio Group or Toggle Group.
responsive: Horizontal sliders fill their container; vertical sliders are 12rem tall. Thumbs never overflow the field.
rtl: Horizontal sliders run right to left and the arrow keys follow the reading direction (ArrowLeft increases).
theme: Component tokens slider-fill (filled track and thumb boundary, falls back to color-primary) and slider-track (color-border-strong), both 3:1 against color-surface in the contrast gate; focus ring color-focus-ring. Forced colors use Highlight and GrayText.
timezone: Not applicable. For times of day, map minutes to the scale and format them with valueText.
security: Labels and value text are rendered with textContent. Positions are set through the CSSOM (CSP-safe, no style attributes).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Any finite min, max, and step; tick marks are limited to 100 (otherwise only the ends).

limitations: Always has a value, so it is never 'missing'; use setCustomError (or Form rules) for range rules.
unsupported: Non-linear (logarithmic) scales; map the value yourself with valueText.
antiPatterns: Sliders as the only way to enter an exact value.
Showing the value only by thumb position (keep showValue or a value text).
